data.description:
# Player thruster SFX — Intake Brief

## Problem Statement

The player ship has no thruster audio feedback. Thruster sound effects should rise continuously from silence to a sustained hum whose volume (and optionally pitch) is proportional to the ship's configured thrust acceleration value, so tuning the `thrustAcceleration` slider (GDD §2.2, `ShipConfig`) is legible by ear as well as by the animated flame.

## Users

- Player piloting the ship in any gym scene (either control scheme), relying on thruster hum to confirm thrust input and tuning changes without watching the flame.
- Developer tuning ship physics via the config sliders, hearing the acceleration change immediately.

## User Stories

- As a player holding a thrust key, I hear a thruster hum that fades in from silence so the onset of thrust is not a click/pop.
- As a player holding thrust at low `thrustAcceleration`, I hear a quieter/lower hum than at high `thrustAcceleration`, so the slider is audible.
- As a player releasing all thrust keys, I hear the hum decay quickly to silence, matching the flame shrink-back.
- As a player switching to the Asteroids scheme, forward thrust and turn thrust (side engines) produce the same thruster hum via the shared `getEngineSoundLevel` interface (VFX-matching key-specific behaviour stays visual-only; audio is a single ship-level hum).

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 — Procedural thruster hum function(s):** `src/audio/effects.ts` exposes a thruster SFX interface (e.g. `startThrusterSound`/`stopThrusterSound`/`setThrusterLevel` or a single `updateThrusterSound(level: number)` that internally manages a sustained oscillator+gain) using Web Audio synthesis (no external assets). Distinct from all existing blip/cue sounds. Degrades to safe no-op without an AudioContext (headless tests, autoplay-blocked browsers).
- **AC2 — Level scales with acceleration value:** The audible level is 0 when not thrusting and rises to a configured maximum when thrusting, scaled by `ShipConfig.thrustAcceleration` (reference `FLAME_REF_THRUST = 300` / `DEFAULT_CONFIG.thrustAcceleration`). At `thrustAcceleration = 0` the hum stays silent (consistent with `flameGrowthRate` returning 0). Higher thrust reaches full volume faster and reads louder/higher — at minimum the gain is proportional to `thrustAcceleration / FLAME_REF_THRUST` (clamped to [0, 1]).
- **AC3 — Rise from nothing (fade-in) and quick decay:** When thrust begins, gain ramps from 0 to the target level over a short window (≤ 100 ms at reference thrust, faster at higher thrust — analogous to `FLAME_GROWTH_TIME_AT_REF = 30 ms`). When thrust stops, gain decays to 0 at ~4× the growth rate (mirroring `FLAME_SHRINK_MULTIPLIER = 4`), with no clicks/pops (gain envelope). Retriggering thrust while still decaying restarts the ramp from the current gain.
- **AC4 — Scheme-agnostic wiring via movement model:** `MovementModel.getEngineSoundLevel` returns a continuous level in [0, 1] for the SFX layer to consume (FourDirectional: 0 when no direction held, 1 when any thrust key held, scaled by acceleration; Asteroids: 0 when idle, 1 when forward/turnLeft/turnRight held, scaled similarly). Player or scene code drives the audio from the model's level each frame (e.g. `Player.preUpdate` or the active scene's update), without affecting physics (`tick` unchanged).
- **AC5 — No overlapping/orphaned audio:** Holding thrust does not stack multiple oscillators; releasing and re-pressing does not leak AudioNodes. Rapid toggling is clean. If the ship is destroyed/respawned or the scene switches, the hum stops.
- **AC6 — Testing/validation:** Unit tests verify (a) the thruster audio node respects AudioContext absence (no-op), (b) `getEngineSoundLevel` returns 0 at idle and > 0 / scaled proportionally when thrusting (including thrust=0 edge case), (c) gain/volume ramping exists (e.g. gain envelope calls or oscillator lifecycle), and (d) scene/Player wiring drives the hum per frame while thrusting and silences it when idle. Full project test suite passes with no regressions.
- **AC7 — Documentation:** GDD §7.3 Audio Direction — Player Audio Character table updated with the thruster hum row (synthesis, wave, contour, volume, thrust-scaling note). Code comments document the thruster interface, thrust-scaling rationale, and autoplay/no-AudioContext fallback.
- **AC8 — Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- Procedural Web Audio only — no external audio assets (GDD §7.3).
- Safe no-op without AudioContext; respects browser autoplay policy (silent until user gesture).
- Must not introduce physics changes — `MovementModel.tick` and flame animation (`src/utils/flame.ts`) remain behaviourally unchanged; only `getEngineSoundLevel` and the audio integration change.
- Volume ceiling ≤ 0.2 to stay consistent with existing player cues (GDD §7.3 "All player cues keep volume ≤ 0.2").
- Backward compatible with both control schemes; does not regress existing VFX (per-engine flame) or shoot/pickup audio.

## Existing State

- `src/utils/movementModel.ts`: `getEngineSoundLevel` is a binary placeholder (returns 0 or 1) for both models; `getEngineActivity` is key-specific (AH-0MTFORPJ2003RWWQ). `flame.ts` already models growth ∝ `thrustAcceleration` with 30 ms to full at ref thrust and 4× decay.
- `src/audio/effects.ts`: 11+ procedural cues (enemy spawn/destruction, Tank/Scout/Diver, Swarm, player shoot/pickups) all via `blip()` or discrete oscillators; no continuous/looping hum and no thruster audio yet.
- `src/entities/Player.ts`: `preUpdate` animates per-engine flame lengths via `getEngineActivity` + `flame.ts`; no audio calls for thrusters. `ShipConfig.thrustAcceleration` defaults to 300 and is live-tunable via gym sliders.
- Docs: GDD §7.3 catalogs player shoot/pickup audio but has no thruster hum entry; §2.2 describes the flame scaling with `thrustAcceleration`.

## Desired Change

- `src/audio/effects.ts`: add a sustained thruster hum (e.g. low sawtooth/square + sine undertone, filtered hum) with an API that a per-frame caller can drive: create/reuse a single oscillator+gain pair, ramp gain from 0 to `level * maxVolume` (level ∈ [0, 1] from the movement model), and stop/cleanup on silence. Ensure exponential/linear gain ramps avoid clicks and the node lifecycle does not leak.
- `src/utils/movementModel.ts`: upgrade `getEngineSoundLevel` from binary to a continuous level scaled by `thrustAcceleration` (e.g. `level = (forward||turn||anyDir ? min(1, thrustAcceleration/FLAME_REF_THRUST) : 0)` or a dedicated param) — or document that the caller scales the binary level by the config value; keep `getEngineActivity` unchanged.
- `src/entities/Player.ts` (or active gym scenes): in `preUpdate`/scene update, derive the current thruster level from `getEngineSoundLevel` + config and call the audio interface each frame; ensure the hum follows the pressed keys (4-dir: any arrow/WASD; Asteroids: W/Up, A/Left, D/Right) and stops when the model reports 0.
- Tests: `src/utils/movementModel.test.ts`, `src/audio/effects.test.ts`, and Player/scene tests updated to assert scaling, no-op, and wiring.
- Docs: GDD §7.3 and inline comments updated.

## Key Files

- `src/audio/effects.ts` — Needs sustained thruster hum with thrust-scaled gain/pitch and safe no-op
- `src/utils/movementModel.ts` — Needs `getEngineSoundLevel` upgraded to continuous [0,1] scaled by thrustAcceleration
- `src/entities/Player.ts` — Needs per-frame audio driving from model level (preUpdate integration); verify no physics change
- `src/utils/flame.ts` — Reference for thrust-proportional growth/decay model (reuse timing constants analogously)
- `src/core/config.ts` — ShipConfig.thrustAcceleration source of scaling; no change expected (read-only)
- `src/utils/movementModel.test.ts` — Needs thruster-level unit tests (binary→scaled, thrust=0 edge)
- `src/audio/effects.test.ts` — Needs thruster hum oscillator/gain + no-op tests
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — §7.3 Player Audio Character — Needs thruster hum row + scaling note

## Related Work

- **AH-0MTFORPJ2003RWWQ** — Asteroids directional VFX improvements (key-specific flame selection; `getEngineSoundLevel` placeholder — direct interface to extend)
- **AH-0MTGBPRYC000QIHU** — Player has no audio (shoot + pickup procedural cues — established `effects.ts` Web Audio patterns and GDD §7.3 Player Audio Character table)
- **AH-0MTF0EFNZ000RPVD** — Alternative player control (pluggable movement models, 3-engine layout, `getEngineSoundLevel` origin Q4)
- **AH-0MT97BW7M0056S8S** — Gym scene with player ship and thrust-based movement (flame VFX, `ShipConfig`)
- **AH-0MTAF5YLT009TXAM** — Thrust flame scales with `thrustAcceleration` (flame.ts growth model — direct scaling precedent)
- **AH-0MTGS4P0V005MTSN** — Add 4 player shoot audio cues (wave-type distinctiveness precedent — thruster hum must stay distinct)

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Scaling basis assumption:** "acceleration value" is interpreted as `ShipConfig.thrustAcceleration` (not velocity or instantaneous force). Gain/pitch thus scales with the config slider; idle = silent, max ≈ 0.15–0.2. If the producer meant a different acceleration metric, the scaling factor can be swapped with minimal code change.
- **Single hum vs per-engine hums:** Assumed single ship-level hum (not one oscillator per engine port). Per-engine layering would complicate mixing and is out of scope; can be added as a follow-up if side-thruster distinctiveness is desired.
- **Continuous vs discrete:** Assumed sustained oscillator+gain (not repeated blips) to meet "rise from nothing" — requires careful AudioNode lifecycle to avoid leaks. Mitigation: single reused node with gain ramping + unit tests for cleanup.
- **Autoplay/silent-until-gesture:** Hum will be silent until the first user interaction (browser policy) — same as all other SFX; documented in GDD §7.3.
- **Scope-creep risk:** Per-engine spatialisation, pitch-bend on velocity, or background music integration are out of scope — track as `discovered-from:AH-0MTFOSOHN001Q620` work items.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions

- Q1 — Scaling basis: "rise from nothing to thruster sound based on the acceleration value" — should the audible level scale with (a) `ShipConfig.thrustAcceleration` (the tuning slider, analogous to flame growth), (b) instantaneous thrust input (binary held/released), (c) current ship velocity, or (d) a combination? Assumed (a) scaled by held-state (binary × config ratio) — confirm or correct. — Answer: *(open — assumed (a); awaiting producer confirmation)* Source: intake assumption; reference `src/core/config.ts:DEFAULT_CONFIG.thrustAcceleration`, `src/utils/flame.ts:flameGrowthRate`.
- Q2 — Hum character: Should the thruster be a continuous looping hum/drone (sustained oscillator with gain ramp) or a one-shot sweep per thrust press? Should it differ between forward vs turn thrust? Assumed continuous single hum with gain ramp, not per-engine distinct tones — confirm. — Answer: *(open — assumed continuous single hum)* Source: intake assumption; reference GDD §7.3 procedural approach, `src/audio/effects.ts` existing continuous cues (Tank whine).
- Q3 — Integration scope: Which scenes should hear the hum — every scene that hosts the player (all gyms + future combat scenes) or a single gym first? Assumed Player-driven in `Player.preUpdate` so every host scene inherits it — confirm scope and whether a mute/volume setting should apply. — Answer: *(open — assumed Player-preUpdate, all host scenes,≤ 0.2 volume)* Source: intake assumption; reference `src/entities/Player.ts:preUpdate`, `src/scenes/gym/*`.
